text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Hmm, well, I suppose that's about right.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, compared to the initial 
demonstration, this is quite an 
evolution."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It seems I've barely managed to keep 
my balance.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
After reconnecting all sorts of modules 
every which way, the posture control got a 
bit better.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, at the very least, we now know 
that the direction of our development 
isn't wrong.
choice_data_list:
Yes. But I still have to keep trying my 
best.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No doubt about it. I barely managed to 
keep up appearances, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Like hell I'm gonna get carried away by 
something like this. Right now, this is 
still just club activity playtime."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
From here, that's what I'll aim for. A 
machine that moves freely, just as I 
envision.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then Trainer. I will require a 
post-race tuning right away. And then—

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"Let us set the next Upgrade Exam for June 
of next year."
choice_data_list: Six months from now, then. Got it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Upgrade Exam concluded. Next, 
it was time to move on to "tuning."
